attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Nevada state income tax using hypothetical progressive tax brackets: 2.5% on first bracket, 4.0% on second bracket, 6.0% on third bracket. Thresholds vary by filing status. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status ($7,500 Single, $15,000 MFJ, $11,250 HOH), then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.nv_state_tax = 0; add "Nevada (no state income tax)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvi /result.nv_state_tax xdef "Nevada (no state income tax)" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: "NEVADA - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.nv_agi xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.nv_bracket_3_tax xdef
